subject.title: feat: expose ClawHub catalog feed lanes

question: Should ClawHub expose root catalog feed lanes now, and must they use stored publications plus distinct feed identities before merge?
rationale: This creates a new public API and trust signal for OpenClaw clients, so the lasting feed contract and delivery model need maintainer intent beyond a mechanical code fix.

options.title: Require snapshot-backed root feeds
options.body: Move the new root lanes onto `catalogFeedPublications` or an equivalent cached, quota-protected publication path before exposing public routes.

options.title: Approve the proposed dynamic API
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept request-time dynamic root feeds plus the reviewed-lane and attestation semantics after documenting the compatibility and trust boundary.

options.title: Pause the feed stack
options.body: Keep the draft paused or close it if the cross-repository feed RFC and OpenClaw consumer contract are not ready to anchor ClawHub producer behavior.

recommendation.title: Require snapshot-backed root feeds
recommendation.body: Move the new root lanes onto `catalogFeedPublications` or an equivalent cached, quota-protected publication path before exposing public routes.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the recent author of the current hosted feed spec and related contract updates.
